# ToolTrim

> Independent SaaS comparison and decision-support catalogue for freelancers, solopreneurs, and small teams.

ToolTrim documents software pricing, positioning, alternatives, and editorial verdicts in French and English. Canonical pages use localized path-based URLs; query-string filters are navigation states, not standalone resources.

## Canonical Pages

- [French home](https://tooltrim.com/fr)
- [English home](https://tooltrim.com/en)
- [French tool catalogue](https://tooltrim.com/fr/tools)
- [English tool catalogue](https://tooltrim.com/en/tools)
- [French category index](https://tooltrim.com/fr/category)
- [English category index](https://tooltrim.com/en/category)
- [French guides](https://tooltrim.com/fr/guides)
- [English guides](https://tooltrim.com/en/guides)
- [French comparisons](https://tooltrim.com/fr/comparatifs)
- [English comparisons](https://tooltrim.com/en/comparatifs)
- [Methodology and transparency](https://tooltrim.com/en/transparency)

## URL Patterns

- Tool: `https://tooltrim.com/{lang}/tool/{slug}`
- Tool as Markdown (facts and verdict, for agents): `https://tooltrim.com/{lang}/tool/{slug}.md`
- Tool pricing: `https://tooltrim.com/fr/tool/{slug}/prix` or `https://tooltrim.com/en/tool/{slug}/pricing`
- Tool reviews: `https://tooltrim.com/fr/tool/{slug}/avis` or `https://tooltrim.com/en/tool/{slug}/reviews`
- Category: `https://tooltrim.com/{lang}/category/{slug}`
- Guide: `https://tooltrim.com/{lang}/guide/{slug}`
- Comparison: `https://tooltrim.com/{lang}/comparatif/{tool-a}-vs-{tool-b}`
- Tool alternatives: `https://tooltrim.com/{lang}/tool/{slug}/alternatives`
- Tool ecosystem: `https://tooltrim.com/{lang}/explorer/around/{slug}`
- Catalogue shard: `https://tooltrim.com/llms-full/{family}.txt`

## Catalogue

- 1257 canonical tool records are included in the generated catalogue.
- [Machine-readable catalogue](https://tooltrim.com/llms-full.txt) — every record in a single file.
- The same records are also published split by category family: one shard per family, same schema (see Catalogue Shards below).
- [Editorial index: guide and comparison summaries](https://tooltrim.com/llms-editorial.txt)
- 108 localized guide pages and 166 localized comparison pages are included in the editorial index, generated from the same build as the sitemap.
- Editorial records provide localized titles, summaries and canonical URLs, not full articles. Read the linked page for the complete analysis.
- Pricing text retains the stated currency and billing period. Missing prices are unknown, not zero; annual or lifetime offers are not converted into monthly EUR prices.
- Prices and descriptions are editorial data, not a promise that a vendor has not changed its offer since publication.
- Check the cited vendor website and the relevant ToolTrim page before quoting a current price.
- `verdict_fr` / `verdict_en` reproduce the verdict published on each tool page: ToolTrim score (average of five evidence-graded axes: added value, simplicity, fit for purpose, power, reversibility; never influenced by payment), who should keep the tool, who should look elsewhere, and its main strengths and weaknesses. Tools without a complete five-axis rating carry no score.
- `price_verified_on` is the date ToolTrim last checked the vendor's pricing page.

The 1257 records of llms-full.txt are also published split by category family, so an agent can fetch one family instead of the whole catalogue. Every shard is a JSON array with the same record schema and the same editorial rules.

## AI Agents: MCP Servers and Skills

- [AI tools hub (FR)](https://tooltrim.com/fr/agents) · [EN](https://tooltrim.com/en/agents)
- [Official MCP servers (FR)](https://tooltrim.com/fr/mcp) · [EN](https://tooltrim.com/en/mcp) — 19 sheets, each with a freelancer's advice: verdict, situations, tips and pitfalls.
- [Official skills (FR)](https://tooltrim.com/fr/skills) · [EN](https://tooltrim.com/en/skills) — 60 sheets.
- MCP server sheet: `https://tooltrim.com/{lang}/mcp/{slug}`
- Skill sheet: `https://tooltrim.com/{lang}/skills/{slug}`
- The full advice of every MCP sheet, in English and French, is at the top of https://tooltrim.com/llms-full.txt, before the tool catalogue.

- [Ahrefs MCP](https://tooltrim.com/en/mcp/ahrefs-mcp): If you already pay for Ahrefs and spend too long exporting tables for clients, plug it in: your assistant queries keywords, links and rankings for you. Every question draws on your plan's units, so keep requests short and precise.
- [Airtable MCP server](https://tooltrim.com/en/mcp/airtable-mcp): If your clients, projects or content live in Airtable, plug it in: your assistant searches, adds and updates your records in plain language. Only give it access to the bases it needs, because it can also delete whole tables.
- [Buffer MCP](https://tooltrim.com/en/mcp/buffer-mcp): If you already schedule your posts with Buffer, plug it in: your assistant drafts, queues and tells you what worked, without switching tabs. Keep the confirmation prompts on, because it can also post right away.
- [Calendly MCP server](https://tooltrim.com/en/mcp/calendly-mcp): If your clients already book through Calendly, plug it in: your assistant finds your slots, creates a booking link and tells you who you're seeing this week. It can also cancel a meeting, so keep a hand on every action.
- [Canva AI Connector](https://tooltrim.com/en/mcp/canva-mcp): If you already make your visuals in Canva, plug in the connector: it works with a free account. But it won't spare you Canva Pro: generating a design uses your Canva AI allowance, and resizing or background removal still need a paid plan.
- [ClickUp MCP Server](https://tooltrim.com/en/mcp/clickup-mcp): If your projects and hours live in ClickUp, plug it in: your assistant spots what's late, adds up your time and creates tasks for you. Keep write actions behind approval, since it notifies your teammates and can post in chat as you.
- [Figma MCP server (desktop)](https://tooltrim.com/en/mcp/figma-mcp-desktop): Only for people who code in Claude Code, Cursor or VS Code with the Figma app open alongside: the assistant reads the frame you select, without ever touching the mockup. For everything else, Figma itself recommends its online server.
- [Figma MCP server (remote)](https://tooltrim.com/en/mcp/figma-mcp): This is the version to pick by default: nothing to install, it works from Claude as well as from a code editor, and it's the only one that can draw in your files. Bear in mind that writing is in beta: what it produces needs reviewing before it reaches a client.
- [Google Analytics MCP server](https://tooltrim.com/en/mcp/google-analytics-mcp): If you're comfortable with a terminal, or someone can set it up for you once, it's worth the effort: you ask your traffic questions in plain words instead of building reports. Otherwise, skip it: it takes Python, a Google Cloud project and credentials to configure.
- [HubSpot MCP server](https://tooltrim.com/en/mcp/hubspot-mcp): If your sales follow-up lives in HubSpot, plug it in: your assistant reads contacts and deals and updates your records, even on the free tools. It deletes nothing, and creating or editing a record waits for your go-ahead.
- [Make MCP server](https://tooltrim.com/en/mcp/make-mcp): If you already have Make scenarios running, plug it in: your assistant runs them in one sentence, on every plan. With no scenario ready, it has nothing to run, and letting it edit them takes a paid plan.
- [Miro MCP Server](https://tooltrim.com/en/mcp/miro-mcp): If your workshops and project plans live in Miro, plug it in, even on the free plan: it sums up your boards and lays down a first draft of frames and notes. It can also share your boards, so keep those actions in your own hands.
- [Notion MCP](https://tooltrim.com/en/mcp/notion-mcp): If your clients and projects already live in Notion and you use Claude or ChatGPT, plug it in: your assistant searches, summarises and writes in your pages, without you moving up to the plan that includes Notion AI.
- [Shopify AI tool integrations](https://tooltrim.com/en/mcp/shopify-mcp): If you sell with Shopify, plug it in: orders, stock, products and discount codes can be handled from the chat. Refunds, payments and store settings stay off-limits, which makes trying it fairly relaxing.
- [Slack MCP server](https://tooltrim.com/en/mcp/slack-mcp): If your clients write to you in Slack, plug it in to find a thread or a file without ten minutes of scrolling. Keep sending behind your approval: the assistant can post in any conversation, under your name.
- [Stripe MCP](https://tooltrim.com/en/mcp/stripe-mcp): If you already bill through Stripe, this server is worth trying for spotting unpaid invoices and preparing invoices and payment links from a chat. Stripe mentions no extra subscription for the server, but the server acts on your live account and can refund or void an invoice: start in a test environment and approve every write action yourself.
- [Tally MCP server](https://tooltrim.com/en/mcp/tally-mcp): If you collect quote requests, sign-ups or feedback with Tally, plug it in: it builds a form from one sentence and reads the responses for you. It deletes nothing, but it's still in beta: review before publishing.
- [Webflow MCP server](https://tooltrim.com/en/mcp/webflow-mcp): If your sites or your clients' run on Webflow, plug it in for the CMS, audits and small fixes. Publishing is the step to watch: always ask to see what changed before going live.
- [Zapier MCP](https://tooltrim.com/en/mcp/zapier-mcp): If your tools have no server of their own, Zapier works as a master key: email, spreadsheet, project management, from the chat. Each successful action draws on your Zapier tasks, so lock what needs locking and watch the counter.

## Citation

When citing ToolTrim, link to the canonical localized page and state the page consulted. Do not cite query-string filter URLs or legacy `/article/` URLs.
